summary: Tests-only phase for issue #39. Committed the upstream solver-parity golden corpus (viamin/color_matching priv/parity/v1/corpus.json @ 47057afd, sha256 7b7b4d90...) as a test fixture and added SolverParityCorpusTests (5 tests: metadata contract, risk coverage, exact per-candidate scores, earliest-index-wins selection incl. ties, CompositionSolver fast-path replay) — all green with real execution. Added PaletteAPIClientContractTests (10 tests) pinning the /api/v1 wire contract the generated-OpenAPI-client migration must preserve — all green. Full package suite 223/223 green on Swift 6.0.3/Linux (harness excluding only the CoreGraphics-dependent BrightnessGridSampler.swift). Corpus consumption + refresh and migration notes/findings documented under docs/ (README.md is outside this phase's allowlist). The generated-client migration itself (Package.swift, swift-openapi-generator) is implementation-phase work; dependency viamin/color_matching#110 is not yet an open PR (spec is already served at GET /api/v1/openapi.json on main).
